evidence: All 35 AF-04 records at batches/AF-04/phase4-path-usage-joins.json omit join_status, although the frozen phase4-join-scaffold-v1.json AF-04 records and both AF-02 and AF-03 phase4-path-usage-joins.v1 records contain it.
All six AF-04 semantic_replacement_requirement objects add status and disclosure relative to the AF-02/AF-03 same-v1 key shape.
batches/AF-04/phase4-group-rollup.json input_path_usage_joins contains only path and omits the joined artifact SHA-256 present in the reviewed AF-03 same-v1 rollup.
role-receipts/AF-04/truth-test-author.json nevertheless sets producer_record_shape_exact, semantic_replacement_requirement_shape_exact, and group_rollup_shape_exact to true.

phase4_batch_contract_test.py validates selected values but does not compare exact producer key sets, require join_status, or require input_path_usage_joins.sha256; therefore its green result cannot refute this mismatch.
high.impact: The AF-04 payload and green receipt disagree about the exact v1 contract, and the missing join-state/self-binding fields can pass the mechanical gate silently. Independent acceptance cannot rely on the receipt as truthful evidence.
high.required_disposition: Fail AF-04 Phase 4 review. A producer correction and fresh truth-test cycle must restore or explicitly version the schema and replace the false shape assertions; this reviewer is not authorized to repair.
